scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "nx serve server" "nx serve client"
scripts.start:tunnel: pkill -f 'tsx.*server/src/index' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'vite client' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; NGROK_CLIENT=$(curl -s http://localhost:4040/api/tunnels | node -e "const d=require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8');const t=JSON.parse(d).tunnels;console.log(t.find(x=>x.config.addr.endsWith('4200')).public_url)"); echo ""; echo "======================================"; echo "  Share this URL with players:"; echo "  $NGROK_CLIENT"; echo "======================================"; echo ""; concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "tsx --tsconfig server/tsconfig.app.json server/src/index.ts" "VITE_TUNNEL=1 VITE_COLYSEUS_ENDPOINT=$NGROK_CLIENT vite client --port 4200"
